scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof for a connected three-Laplacian-eigenvalue graph family; 45,967 exact finite checks corroborate rather than certify its infinite scope; special cases covered by earlier graph-family results are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric connected weighted Laplacians with precisely two distinct positive eigenvalues, and the fourth-order [2/2] Pade map. Potential equivalent literature remains a residual originality risk; independent audit not performed.
title: A sharp all-step positivity criterion for fourth-order diffusion with three Laplacian eigenvalues
